sources.title: LiquidAI releases d1-3B and d1-omni-600M decision models with zero ...
sources.snippet: LiquidAI has released two new decision models, d1-3B and d1-omni-600M, which return typed answers in a single forward pass with zero output tokens by reading directly from the model's distribution over options.
